items.title: Stock Radar: Divi’s Laboratories stock hits fresh record high in July 2026; time to book profits or buy the dip?
items.description: Divi's Laboratories stock reached a new record high in July 2026. Chart patterns indicate continued upward momentum for the pharma stock. Short-term traders can consider buying the stock for a target of 8,000 levels. The stock has shown significant gains over recent weeks and months. Experts recommend buying with a stop loss below 6950 levels.

items.title: India's private banks draw thinner margins on tepid credit growth
items.description: Top private sector banks reported weaker net interest margins (NIMs) in the June quarter as sluggish retail loan demand pushed them towards lower-yielding corporate loans. HDFC Bank's NIM fell to 3.26%, Kotak Mahindra Bank's dropped to a 19-quarter low of 4.53%, while Axis Bank's stood at 3.46%.

items.title: Indian banks mobilise $20.7 billion under RBI's special incentive window
items.description: In a remarkable financial boost, India's central bank recorded significant foreign exchange inflows of $20.72 billion, primarily through a swap facility provided by the Reserve Bank of India. Out of this amount, Foreign Currency Non-Resident Deposits accounted for $17.41 billion. Meanwhile, External Commercial Borrowings contributed $1.34 billion, and Overseas Foreign Currency Borrowings brought in an additional $1.97 billion, enhancing the country’s economic standing.

items.title: Alpine Texworld shares to debut today; GMP signals muted listing
items.description: Alpine Texworld shares:  The stock is expected to debut with only a marginal gain, as the grey market premium stands at about 1%, implying a listing price of around Rs 106 against the upper issue price of Rs 105. The IPO, which was open from July 14 to July 16, was subscribed 1.40 times overall, reflecting moderate investor demand.

items.title: Premier Energies among 5 stocks closed above VWAP, signalling bullish shift
items.description: On July 20, the closing prices of five stocks in the Nifty500 pack rallied more than 1.5% above their Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP), according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A move above the VWAP suggests a potential bullish trend, as it indicates that the stock is trading above its average price for the session after accounting for trading volumes.When the closing price rises above the VWAP, it means the closing price is higher than the average price at which the stock traded throughout the day, with the average weighted by trading volume. Traders and investors often interpret this as a bullish signal, reflecting positive market sentiment and the possibility of continued upward momentum.

items.title: Union Bank of India among 7 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
items.description: On July 20, seven stocks in the Nifty500 appeared on the 'White Marubozu' bullish scanner, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns to assess the potential continuation of upward momentum.

items.title: PNB among 4 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On July 20, four stocks from the Nifty500 segment that gained over 3.5% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from lower levels.“RSI trending up” indicates that Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price action. This can indicate potential upward movement and is often used by traders to identify buying opportunities in momentum-driven markets.

items.title: SBI Funds Management gets 2 buy calls before listing. Why Equirus, Emkay see up to  31% upside
items.description: The firms have set target prices of Rs 675 and Rs 750 for March and June 2027, implying an upside of up to 31% from the IPO issue price of Rs 574.

items.title: SBI Funds Management IPO to list today; GMP signals 17% premium debut
items.description: Ahead of the listing, SBI Funds Management shares are commanding a Grey Market Premium (GMP) of around Rs 97. Based on the upper end of the IPO price band at Rs 574, the GMP points to an estimated listing price of nearly Rs 671, implying a potential 17% listing gain for investors.

items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, 13 stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200 DMA (Daily Moving Averages) on July 20, 2026, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. The 200-day daily moving average (DMA) is a key indicator traders use to determine the overall trend in a particular stock. items.title: Triveni Engineering demerger: Last day to buy stock to get Triveni Power Transmission shares. Check details
items.description: The company, which is associated with the production of sugar and ethanol along with engineering works, announced earlier this year that as part of its demerger of its power transmission business, every eligible shareholder get one share of Triveni Power Transmission for every three shares held in Triveni Engineering as on the record date.

items.title: Sebi imposes Rs 1 crore fine on CDSL
items.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India fined CDSL one crore rupees. This penalty addresses cybersecurity and operational lapses following a malware attack. The depository failed to adequately secure critical systems, which disrupted operations. CDSL's systems were isolated from the market after the incident. No monetary penalty was imposed on former top officials.

items.title: D-St set for a negative opening as GIFT Nifty signals weak start
items.description: Equity markets faced pressure as Nifty declined, while broader markets showed gains. Analysts expect sideways to mixed trading due to geopolitical tensions and oil prices. The Indian rupee weakened to its lowest level in two months on Monday. India VIX, a fear index, saw a slight decrease settling at 12.98. Stock-specific action is anticipated as the Q1 earnings season progresses.

items.title: Stocks in news: CDSL, Adani Energy, L&T, Adani Total Gas, Emcure Pharma
items.description: Markets declined on Monday due to disappointing earnings and geopolitical worries.  CDSL faced a Rs 1 crore penalty from Sebi for cybersecurity lapses.  Several companies will announce their first quarter financial results today.  Grasim Industries invested Rs 74,000 crore in capital expenditure over five years.  Larsen & Toubro secured multiple mega orders for its metals business.

items.title: Strong Q1 sets stage for FY27 growth as UltraTech bets on cables business
items.description: UltraTech Cement reported its strongest first quarter volume and profit ever.  Near-term performance faces monsoon seasonality and higher input costs.  The company anticipates double-digit volume growth in the next fiscal year.  Its new cables and wires business will launch in the third quarter.  Lower stock valuation offers a cushion against potential downside risks.

items.title: Private banks go for a tumble on D-St after Q1 stumble
items.description: Most private lender stocks declined Monday after first-quarter earnings showed profitability pressures. Axis Bank and HDFC Bank saw significant drops, while ICICI Bank gained. Analysts noted margin compression as a key factor affecting banking stocks. Foreign investors returned to financials after substantial withdrawals earlier in the year. ICICI Bank remains a top pick among leading private sector lenders.

items.title: First Bell: SBI Funds' investors in line for 10-15% listing pop
items.description: SBI Funds Management's stock is anticipated to debut at a premium of ten to fifteen percent.  The company's initial public offering was subscribed over forty-one times on its final day.  Analysts suggest investors can book profits or hold shares for long-term gains.  The IPO price valued SBI Funds Management at over one lakh crore rupees.  This listing is expected to narrow the valuation gap with its listed peers.
